_doc: CA land-secured / Mello-Roos CFD universe for detector-composition framework
_methodology: Compiled May 2026 from CDIAC Mello-Roos YFSR Summary RY 2023-24 (published Jan 2025), CDIAC Mello-Roos YFSR Report 2018-19 (CDIAC No. 21.06), CDIAC Default & Draw on Reserve database, Patterson CFD 2018-1 actual CDIAC filing (2024-0147), San Joaquin County CFD No 2009-2 actual CDIAC filing (2012-0441), Roseville Creekview Phase 5 CFD 1 Series 2025 Official Statement (Nov 25, 2025), and ElevenFlo case study on Diablo Grande Ch 9 bankruptcy (Nov 25, 2025).
_caveats: Per CDIAC YFSR schema, value-to-lien ratio is DERIVED (Total Assessed Value / Principal Outstanding) and is NOT a directly reported field. Build-out percentage is NOT a YFSR field — only available in Official Statements / Continuing Disclosure Annual Reports. Top-taxpayer concentration is NOT in YFSR — only in OS/CDA. Coverage ratio is NOT in YFSR — only in CDA. CDIAC YFSR DOES directly provide: Principal Outstanding, Reserve Fund balance, Reserve Minimum, Capitalized Interest, Construction Fund, Assessed Value, Total Special Taxes Due Annually, Special Taxes Unpaid, Delinquent Parcels, Foreclosure activity, Teeter Plan participation. CDIAC also runs separate Default & Draw on Reserve reporting (10-day window). So the union screen should anchor on YFSR-derived V/L + delinquency + reserve-drawn + foreclosure; build-out / top-taxpayer / coverage detectors are FILING-DEPENDENT (need OS or annual CDA report).

_universe_construction_principles.bias: Housing-development CFDs in cycle-exposed markets (Inland Empire, Central Valley, exurban Sacramento, exurban San Diego). Plus boring school-district / municipal-service CFDs as control. Plus historical defaulted CFDs from CDIAC database as backtest baseline.
_universe_construction_principles.explicit_inclusions: All 10 CFDs from CDIAC RY2023-24 Top-Delinquent list (Figure 9); all 10 CFDs from CDIAC RY2023-24 Largest-AV list (Figure 5) as clean controls; historical defaulters (Diablo Grande, Riverside Co 88-8, Calexico 2005-1, Truckee Donner 04-1, Northstar 1, Lake Elsinore 2007-5, Beaumont 93-1).

cfds._notes: Gold-standard 'exclude' case. 28,500-acre master planned resort + housing community begun early 1990s; stalled. 103 parcels acquired through foreclosure 2023-2025. Filed Ch 9 Nov 25 2025. Stanislaus County (Central Valley exurban). 74.6% delinquency = #3 in CA in RY 2023-24.

100% unpaid special tax in RY 2023-24 ($32.3M unpaid against $32.3M due). Largest absolute unpaid amount of any CFD in the state's top-delinquency list (#2 by total $). Outstanding debt only $22.7M so this is an unusual large-arrears low-debt situation — likely cumulative arrears across years on a small remaining bond issue.

Border-housing CFD with chronic delinquency ($10.4M cumulative arrears against $9.2M outstanding bonds — arrears now exceed bond principal). #5 by % unpaid in RY 2023-24. Imperial County is the highest-stress county by % unpaid in the state.
